summary: Iteration 4 — full verification of role system + admin dashboard, MoodEmojiBurst on chat, 'Personal Voice Journal' tagline, Manage password (Google) link, and Pydantic-typed MBTI scores. Backend: 20/20 new pytest tests pass (auth/me role exposure, /api/admin/users + /api/admin/stats with 200/403 matrix, role updates with full authority rules, super-admin demotion safeguard, regular-admin can't grant admin / can't delete, super-admin cascade delete verified across all 9 user content collections, Pydantic 400 on invalid scores, empty {} defaults to 0, regression on /notes/text /timeline /profile /ai/categorize). Frontend: tagline 'Personal Voice Journal' present in header (uppercase via CSS), footer ('© 2026 Giridhar Alwar · PericL · Personal Voice Journal'), and login. Regular user menu shows only profile/personality/privacy/manage-password/logout (no admin). Click on menu-manage-password opens https://myaccount.google.com/intro/security in a new tab. Regular user navigating to /admin gets redirected to /. Super admin /admin loads with users-list (3 rows), stats cards, search filter, role badges, and Make admin/Demote buttons; SA menu shows 'Admin (super)'. Make-admin → demote round-trip works via UI buttons. Mood emoji burst: happy message → 14 emojis from happy pool (💥🎊⚡🎉🌟…) appear within ~1s and clear within 8s; stressed message → emojis include supportive 🫂🕯️💚☁️✨ from stressed pool. Burst rerenders fresh per send.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_set_role: when admin.role != 'super_admin' and target.role is admin/super_admin, returns 403 — good. But a regular admin can still hit the endpoint to change a 'user' to 'user' (no-op). Consider rejecting same-role updates to reduce write churn.

server.py admin_delete_user cascades over a hard-coded list of 9 collections. If a new collection is added (e.g., for a future feature) it will be missed during account deletion. Consider a registry pattern or a single 'user_data' tag/index.

Header.jsx tagline span has class `text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider` — DOM text 'Personal Voice Journal' is rendered uppercase. Good for visuals; just be aware automated string match must be case-insensitive.

MoodEmojiBurst.jsx triggers parallel /api/ai/categorize call; this still hits the cloud LLM in local-mode privacy users on every chat send. If privacy is a strict promise, gate the burst's mood request behind storage_mode, or at least disable categorize call when mode='local' (mood pool can be picked client-side via a tiny keyword heuristic for local users).
